Worse, that crop would push the finch's head out of frame, and the shot's whole action is "tips head back to swallow, dips again" — the swallow would happen off-screen. Crop is strictly worse than the full frame here.

WHY respec_prompt: the still is excellent and on-style (flat overcast, desaturated, green spined pad, black lava, blurred pale sea, blunt seed-cracking beak buried among the petals on the bloom's right side, bird camera-right). The narrative job is small and fully satisfiable: VO [4:52] in EP02_SCRIPT_LOCKED.md line 74 is literally "Nectar from a cactus flower," and this frame IS a finch drinking from a cactus flower. The overhead-macro framing was a distinctness device invented in the audit (EP02_SHOT_MANIFEST_FULL.md line 894 proposed generating exactly this SEED_pricklypear_top; the seed came back side-on, so the fix never landed), not a story requirement. The prompt's own "beak enters from the right" and the dip/tip-back/dip action both already match frame 1.

DISTINCTNESS still holds under the rewrite. S047 (previous) is a worm's-eye XCU up out of a lava crack with the head dropping in from above; S049 (next) is a water-level CU across a seawater tide crack with the whole standing bird. The respec'd S048 is level with the bloom, close on head + shoulder, dominated by a big yellow flower and cactus spines — different angle and different visual palette from both neighbours. No adjacent pair repeats.

TWO DELIBERATE CHOICES IN THE REWRITE:
1. No push-in / no zoom. It was tempting to recover the "get tighter" intent with a slow drift toward the bloom, but the shot is 6.4s against Grok's 6.04s cap and its coverage_note calls for two invisible-cut gens joined on a match cut. Both gens start at the same framing, so any push makes the framing jump backwards at the seam. Locked + handheld breathing keeps the seam unreadable.
2. If the editor still wants extra size separation from S049, take it as a ~1.2x punch-in on the DELIVERED clip in the assembler — free, post-gen, and it cannot break the seed or the match cut.

Riders preserved: grit prefix verbatim at the start, "no extra limbs" kept, physics rider on beak-vs-petal contact and no liquid threads (physics_risk medium), "only the bird moves." No DRY-blood rider (has_blood=False). No booby in frame, so the head-on rule is not implicated. Word "hunch" not used.
